headline: Generative AI is used in 12 out of every 1,000 hours worked in Mexico, estimates Centro-i
summary: Generative AI accounted for 12 of every 1,000 hours worked in Mexico in the first half of 2026, up from 0.4% in 2024. The Centro-i study estimates the productivity gain that usage could provide.
why: Adoption of generative AI in the workforce is a major driver of expected productivity gains across sectors.
original_headline: La IA generativa se usa en 12 de cada 1,000 horas trabajadas en México, estima Centro-i
